failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 provides detailed analysis of passages about 'Thalictrum dioicum' (passage 5), 'Thalictrum sparsiflorum' (passage 6) with 'detailed flower anatomy (sepals, stamens, anthers)' when the claim verification was already complete after hop 1, which established both Parodia and Thalictrum are flowering plants.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'No query needed - the claim has been definitively contradicted by the provided passages.' This is not a retrieval query but a natural-language statement of task completion, unusable by the retrieval system.

failure_modes.name: Downstream_Handoff_Failure
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 coordinator output 'No query needed - the claim has been definitively contradicted by the provided passages.' lacks proper query structure required by the retrieval system, yet hop 3 retrieval still executed and returned 10 documents about query rewriting, GraphQL, stereotypes, and Quran criticism—completely irrelevant to the plant genera claim.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents (Query Rewriting, Incompatible-properties argument, GeoSPARQL, Apache Hive, Minimal counterexample, Facebook Query Language, GraphQL, SEDAT, Stereotype, Criticism of the Quran) that are completely irrelevant to verifying botanical claims about Parodia and Thalictrum genera, yet these were included in final output concatenation without any flag that they are off-topic.
